bhūmir bhūmim agān mātā mātaram apy agāt bhūyāsma putraiḥ paśubhir yo no dveṣṭi sa bhidyatām iti ||

kṣatriyāt pañcaviṃśat tu brāhmaṇād daśa kīrtitāḥ ||

api vā pratiśaucam ā maṇibandhācchucir iti baudhāyanaḥ ||
brahmaṇā munimukhyaiś ca tasmāt taṃ dhārayet sadā ||
tataḥ śaucaṃ tataḥ pānaṃ saṃdhyopāsanam eva ca |
kuryācchuddhena manasā na cittaṃ dūṣayed budhaḥ sahakamaṇḍalunotpannaḥ svayaṃbhūs tasmāt kamaṇḍalunā caret ||

yathā hi somasaṃyogāc camaso medhya ucyate |
apāṃ tathaiva saṃyogān nityo medhyaḥ kamaṇḍaluḥ ||
tasmād vinā kamaṇḍalunā nādhvānaṃ vrajen na sīmantaṃ nagṛhād gṛham ||
